title: Rockstar confirms the next GTA is in development
text: In a GTA Online community update, Rockstar said active development on the next entry in the series was well underway.

title: Rockstar confirms a network intrusion and leaked early footage
text: Rockstar acknowledged that early development footage of the next GTA had been stolen and posted online, and said work would continue as planned.

title: First trailer announced for early December
text: Marking Rockstar's 25th anniversary, Sam Houser said the first trailer for the next Grand Theft Auto would arrive in early December.

title: Trailer 1 released
text: Posted a day early after leaking. Revealed the title, Lucia, Vice City and a 2025 window.

title: Take-Two narrows the window to fall 2025
text: Take-Two's earnings release said the game was expected in fall 2025.

title: Delayed to May 26, 2026
text: Rockstar apologised for the extra wait and said it wanted to deliver at the level of quality players expect.

title: Trailer 2 and full site refresh
text: Second trailer, 70 screenshots, and official pages for Jason, Lucia, the supporting cast and Leonida's regions.

title: Delayed to November 19, 2026
text: Rockstar moved the launch to Thursday, November 19, 2026, citing the polish players expect and deserve.

title: Cover art and editions revealed; pre-order date set
text: Rockstar set June 25 for pre-orders, unveiled the Ultimate Edition and the Vintage Vice City Pack, and released a cover art reveal video.

title: Pre-order details and pricing
text: A Newswire post and Take-Two press release confirmed $79.99 Standard and $99.99 Ultimate pricing, storefronts, and November 12 pre-load and physical availability.

title: Pre-orders open
text: Midnight local time, digital and physical.

title: 'An Extended Look' announced for August 27
text: Newswire post and teaser: a Netflix premiere at 3 p.m. ET, then YouTube and the official site at 9 p.m. ET.

title: Rockstar addresses the gameplay leaks
text: The day before the Extended Look premiere, Rockstar called the leaked videos heartbreaking for the team and asked fans to wait for the real thing.

title: 'An Extended Look' premieres
text: Netflix at 3 p.m. ET, then YouTube and the official site at 9 p.m. ET.

title: 30 fps at launch confirmed
text: Rockstar North's Rob Nelson told a visiting creator the consoles are running the game at 30 fps for now.

title: Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album announced
text: 34 original tracks with Atlantic Records, out November 19; first six songs released.

title: Pre-load and physical availability (upcoming)
text: Digital pre-loading starts and physical code-in-box copies become available.

title: Launch (upcoming)
text: PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. The Album releases the same day.
